background.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create a 16:9 visual-novel background: the modest private library of a rural gentleman in La Mancha, Spain, early seventeenth century. Whitewashed plaster walls, dark timber ceiling beams, rough terracotta floor, shelves crowded with worn leather-bound books on left and rear edges, a small side table with two books at far left, a small open window at far right looking into a sunlit courtyard. Broad unobstructed central foreground for two full-body animated characters. No people, no legible lettering, no fire, no modern objects. Clean dark slate outlines, muted warm cream and brown colours, restrained cel shadows, simplified manga-inspired graphic-novel scenery that suits polished SVG characters. Eye-level camera. Clear readable shapes, subdued contrast, no photorealism or painterly texture, no border.

sealedBackground.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This reference image is the existing courtyard background in a Don Quixote visual novel. Create a matching version AFTER the household has burned the books and concealed the library entrance. Replace the open wooden doorway into the library (left third of frame), including the door, visible room interior and shelves, with a continuous freshly white-plastered wall flush with the surrounding wall. No doorway outline, no handle or visible books in that area. Also remove the two closed books and loose writing papers from the far-left table; retain the table, vase, quill and other non-book objects. Preserve everything else: exact courtyard composition, open garden gate on the right, distant countryside, foliage, well, furniture, sunlight, warm muted manga linework, and clear central foreground. No people, text, fire or new objects. Keep the same landscape frame.
